verdict.rationale: An infrastructure-as-code product could plausibly offer AI-generated insights over plans, state, or workspaces, so this axis applies. However, the pack documents no in-product AI insight or suggestion feature. The Terraform MCP server only gives external AI models access to registry docs, modules, policies, and workspaces, which is a building block for outside agents and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
